dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature with a prominent V-shaped notch located at the approximate midpoint and several smaller irregular nicks along the proximal edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a small pixel radius, containing visible micro-notches or terminal wear.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an angular ascent of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Width of the visible fin base to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.5:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches on the posterior margin including one large central excision; presence of numerous white punctate marks or possible parasitic lesions scattered across the lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, irregularly shaped mottled patch on the mid-lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
